Biden.description: Public discussion of US President Joe Biden covering policy, elections, age, and leadership, drawn from Reddit threads.
Biden.favor_reason: Support often cites experienced governance, social programs, climate policy, and coalition-building in national politics.
Biden.against_reason: Criticism often cites age, inflation, border policy, and doubts about effectiveness or electability.

Bitcoin.description: Public discussion of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency and store of value, including markets, regulation, energy use, and adoption.
Bitcoin.favor_reason: Support often cites decentralization, inflation hedge narratives, peer-to-peer payments, and long-term adoption.
Bitcoin.against_reason: Criticism often cites volatility, energy consumption, illicit use, and doubts that it functions as everyday money.

SpaceX.description: Public discussion of SpaceX covering reusable rockets, Starlink, crewed flight, and commercial spaceflight.
SpaceX.favor_reason: Support often cites reusable launch cost reductions, Starlink connectivity, and rapid engineering iteration.
SpaceX.against_reason: Criticism often cites debris and spectrum concerns, regulatory fights, and dependence on a single founder-led firm.

Tesla.description: Public discussion of Tesla covering electric vehicles, Autopilot, manufacturing, and Elon Musk-related company news.
Tesla.favor_reason: Support often cites EV performance, charging network, over-the-air updates, and accelerating electric adoption.
Tesla.against_reason: Criticism often cites build quality, Autopilot safety claims, service issues, and volatility around leadership.

Trump.description: Public discussion of Donald Trump covering elections, legal cases, rhetoric, and Republican politics.
Trump.favor_reason: Support often cites economic record, immigration stance, outsider politics, and opposition to established institutions.
Trump.against_reason: Criticism often cites democratic norms, legal controversies, rhetoric, and policy outcomes opposed by critics.
